verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a UI Playground for rapidly testing and iterating on prompts ([helicone-gh-3], [helicone-gh-6]). Prompts built there can be saved with commit history and tags ([helicone-docs-46]). Its prompt system supports variables in system prompts, messages and tool schemas ([helicone-docs-44]), and the gateway reaches 100+ real models by changing the model name ([helicone-docs-3]). missing for 10: explicit docs showing variable inputs and model selection inside the Playground itself (currently only implied by the prompt and gateway docs), independent or hands-on corroboration of Playground use.
